title: Server activity timeline
detail: New Details button on every server card: server info plus a live step-by-step log of everything that happened (deploys, logins, pause/resume, errors).

title: Pause & resume servers
detail: Pause snapshots your server and shuts it down (~$1/mo instead of ~$18/mo). Resume restores it in ~3 minutes with workspace, logins and connections intact.

title: Static IP option
detail: New deploy checkbox: keep the same IP address for the server's lifetime — survives pause/resume. +$2/mo.

title: Static IP correctly re-attaches after resume
detail: Resumed servers briefly came back on a new address while the dashboard showed the pinned one.

title: Agents learn persistence rules
detail: New agents are told to prefer user-space installs (pip --user, venvs) so their tools survive restarts and backups.

title: Prepaid billing
detail: Credit wallet with Stripe top-ups ($10/$25/$50), transparent hourly server billing ($0.60/day), Multi plan ($9/mo, up to 5 servers), full transaction history in Settings.

title: Usage & cost dashboards
detail: Settings shows each server's hours and costs; balance banner warns before credits run out.

title: Slack integration, polished
detail: One-click pre-configured Slack app creation (pick your bot's name), native slash commands (/model, /mode, /new…), @mentions in channels, image & file exchange.

title: No more duplicate Slack replies
detail: Channel mentions were processed twice (and the bot could answer itself). Event subscriptions corrected.

title: Connecting a platform no longer asks for an API key
detail: Subscription-login agents were wrongly prompted for a key when adding Slack/Telegram.

title: Agents know how to send files to chat
detail: Workspaces are seeded with instructions for delivering files/images back to Slack or Telegram — no more invented excuses.

title: Full autonomy by default
detail: Agents default to full-autonomy mode: each runs in an isolated container (that is the sandbox), and restricted modes caused confusing refusals.

title: ChatGPT subscription login for Codex
detail: Guided device-code login: open a link, enter the one-time code, done — no API key needed.

title: Claude subscription login
detail: Log in to Claude Code on your server with your Claude subscription via a guided OAuth flow — no API key needed.

title: Two-step deploy flow
detail: Deploy a server with just a region pick; choose Claude Code or Codex and how to sign in once it's ready.

title: Deploys are ~5x faster
detail: Servers pull a prebuilt agent image instead of compiling everything — setup dropped from up to 15 minutes to ~2–3.

title: Reliable first-boot setup
detail: Server setup could silently fail racing system updates at first boot; now it retries, and any failure is reported on the server card.

title: AgentQuarters launches 🎉
detail: Deploy an always-on AI coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) to your own cloud server in minutes, and chat with it from Telegram or Slack.
